operation: Adapt four complete physically copied historical V8/V9 main workflow scripts in their new owned directory. Main provenance consolidates the historical generator and orchestration provenance; no old runtime import, dot-source, forwarding, script invocation or historical source edit.

context_plan_contract.plan_path: Bounded relative existing embedding metadata path, supplied later by root
context_plan_contract.context_inputs: Exactly12 unique id/host_repository/host_path/bytes/sha256 records. Actual metadata must already be complete. Generator creates frozen source/preservation/{id}.json aliases.
context_plan_contract.context_assertions: Six {input,path:[literal metadata keys],equals:typed value} records: preservation status passed/count109, retention review passed, applied true, ledger/catalog CPB-v3.market-01. Actual selector paths are externally supplied and reviewed later.
context_plan_contract.preservation_pins: Optional actual extra hash-only rows, with id/host_repository/host_path/container_path/bytes/sha256. Copied paths may only alias one exact existing context; no future preservation hash is fabricated.
context_plan_contract.numeric_and_hash_paths: Closed immutable design002 supplies every25+34 original path and byte/hash. DEV train-target label is normalized without ../; opaque PT and numerical JSON bytes are hashed only.
context_plan_contract.source_admission: All ten scientific source bytes must still match reviewed source-ready002/root review002. All ten workflow helpers are frozen into the prospective card and rechecked at separate admission/preflight.
context_plan_contract.final_context_policy: Require actual completed normal V11 109-checkpoint/132-source preservation and applied stronger22 protocol. Historical V9 recovery is opaque preserved context; no current V11 report recovery or old scientific replay.

card_interfaces.state_transition: prepare-card.ps1 -Phase Propose creates execution_admitted=false. A separately reviewed -Phase Admit with external proposed SHA creates new true ADMITTED bytes and pins preserved prospective card. No overwrite or implicit arithmetic admission.
card_interfaces.host_binding: Every role has bounded host_repository/host_path/path plus absolute container_path; physical path aliases must bind equal bytes/hash.
card_interfaces.counts: Logical occurrences=25+34+12+len(optional preservation)+1; unique host/runtime paths tracked independently. Broad pre-execution receipt aliases the frozen v11_final_preservation context.

workflow_interfaces.preflight: RootReviewedSourceAndCard/CardSha256/OrchestrationHelperSha256; exact admitted/prospective relationship, closed selector/role/source/hash/metadata/declared PT ignore checks only. Hash each physical role file once; no broad109 checkpoint inventory re-verification.
workflow_interfaces.transport: Owned sources5+ADMITTED card+preflight+actual12 declared context copies; source payload/ZIP membership counted dynamically. Own stdlib recorder, exact manifest and ZIP are separately hashed. No extra duplicate broad-preservation file.
workflow_interfaces.Stage: Inspect exact existing immutable cuwacunu/image, sole DEV bind and GPU-all; no lifecycle. Exclusive source/host leaves, exact transport/member/role hashes and three Python AST parses; no project import or tensor values.
workflow_interfaces.Schema: Separate root admission and exact Stage SHA. Owned schema.py receives positional CARD_PATH CARD_SHA; validates inert archive metadata without storage values and returns model_calls=0.
workflow_interfaces.Run: Separate root admission with exact Stage/Schema/transport hashes; exclusive start/receipt/logs and nonblocking flock. Owned diagnose.py --card PATH --card-sha256 SHA --output LEAF once only. Every original role and staged source is hashed before/after; no retry.
workflow_interfaces.Mirror: Whole current capsule/run mirror with exact before/after container inventory and every member hash. Preserve failed/partial evidence. On successful actual body, exclusively copy diagnosis.json, execution.json and mirror.json to new diagnosis doc.
workflow_interfaces.audit_handshake: Audit owner uses independent-audit-card.PROPOSED.json then separate .ADMITTED.json, and canonical independent-audit.json/independent-audit-execution.json/independent-audit-mirror.json. It receives main ADMITTED card/diagnosis/mirror external hashes.
workflow_interfaces.Completion: Externally reviewed final human report/main and audit cards/results/mirrors; metadata/hash joins only. Validate positive exact five-family affine counts and positive implementation-dependent scalar calls separately from zero model/module/head/fit/update counters. Actual audit check count is dynamic; no256 finite differences or old four-stage/V11 trust reruns.
